slides.text: Glance Pay — hands-free stablecoin payments on Even Realities G2 smart glasses. DeFi track, Heads Up hackathon.
Part one: the G2 lens app payment flow. The G2 has no camera, no speaker — just a monochrome green display at 576 by 288. Tap the glasses or R1 ring to start listening.
LISTENING state: raw microphone PCM streams to our backend for speech-to-text. The parser extracts amount and merchant — say 'pay twelve fifty to Café X'.
PICK_MERCHANT: nearby merchants sorted by GPS distance. Scroll the ring or temple to choose, tap to select. No auto-pay — every transaction is explicit.
CONFIRM shows merchant, rupees, and USDC equivalent on one glanceable line. Tap ring or glasses to authorize. Our backend signs a real test USDC transfer on Ethereum Sepolia.
PENDING: on-chain verification polls for the receipt. SUCCESS: verified on-chain, receipt emailed via Resend. The phone panel speaks: 'Payment confirmed.'
Part two: the web admin dashboard. Connect MetaMask — auto-switches to Sepolia. Merchant picker shows GPS distances: Café X at fifty meters, Blue Tokai at one-twenty meters.
Admin tab: onboard new merchants with name, GPS coordinates, UPI URI, and category. All stored locally for the demo; production swaps for the payout partner API.
Network panel: Ethereum Sepolia chain 11155111, USDC contract address, verified on-chain receipts with Etherscan links. Every payment is auditable end-to-end.

Part three: architecture. G2 lens app talks to Even Hub SDK over Bluetooth. Web panel and G2 app both call the Node backend API. Backend signs real USDC transfers on Sepolia, verifies on-chain via RPC, emails receipts via Resend. No mock path — real on-chain settlement.
